content.title: AKU joins the International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education
content.summary: The International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education has accepted the Aga Khan University as an associate member.

media.alt: AKU joins the International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education
AKU joins the International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education

content.text: The International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education has accepted the Aga Khan University as an associate member. The membership has been granted in recognition of the University's excellent work in the area of quality assurance in higher education.

"This is a testament to AKU's commitment to the highest academic standards to ensure students have the best of learning experiences at par with any respected university in the world," said Dr Tashmin Khamis, Director, AKU's Networks of Quality Assurance and Improvement, and Teaching and Learning.

AKU's firm commitment to cultivating a culture of quality in education has been acknowledged by the Inter-University Council of East Africa and the Higher Education Commission. Both have recognized the role AKU's QAI_net has been playing in improving the academic quality of programmes according to international best practices.

"By becoming a member of INQAAHE, AKU has access to enormous reassurance, support and assistance in our daily quality assurance work, including a Good Practice database and guidelines, peer mentoring on QA and sharing of lessons through the INQAAHE Bulletin and journal Quality in Higher Education," stated Dr Khamis.

INQAAHE is a global association of over 200 organizations active in the theory and practice of quality assurance in higher education. The majority of its members are quality assurance regulatory agencies, including those in countries where AKU has campuses.
